# Resource Groups

Group resources with tag-based or CloudFormation stack queries, resolved against the same resources the Tagging API lists.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `resourcegroups` |
| Signing name | `resource-groups` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2017-11-27` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 17 of 23 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#resource-groups) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- GroupResources and UngroupResources are not supported, so configuration-based groups have no members and ListGroupingStatuses is always empty.
- Group configurations are stored but not validated beyond their shape; service-linked behavior such as capacity reservation pools is not run.
- Resource types are derived from each inventory type (AWS::<Service>::<Type>); types of services TinyStack has no inventory for report RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED.
- Stack queries match resources by physical ID, so stack resources absent from the inventory are left out, and an inactive stack reports as not existing.
- Group lifecycle events and application tags are not emitted; the name/ID group form is not accepted.
- IAM policies are not evaluated.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
